title: Ghostty in Eorzea: media quests
about: Shots, GIFs and videos for the README, the plugin listing and the homepage. Every quest names where to stand, when (Eorzea time; 1 Eorzean hour = 2 min 55 s), the weather it wants, what to set up in Ghostty, and what to capture. Locations are reachable from Limsa Lominsa on foot or by ferry at level 10. XivMcp's get_weather_forecast finds the next matching window; set_map_flag marks the spot. Map coordinates are approximate starting points; the in-game quest tracker refines them.
before_every_shot: Capture with /term shot, not the game's screenshot key: the game photographs the frame before Dalamud draws, so the terminals may not be in its file. /term shot panel crops to the terminal in focus and /term shot clean hides the game's UI (docs/CAPTURE.md).

GIFs and short videos: /term clip [seconds] gif|mp4 records the frames and ghostty-agent encodes them with ffmpeg on the host (6 s at 10 fps, 1280x720 by default). Clips are for these quests; the gallery takes PNG and JPEG only.
Use /term showcase or fresh terminals: never capture your own shells, tokens or chat.
Hide your name: Character Configuration > UI Settings > Nameplates > Own name: never (or crop).
Hide the game HUD with Scroll Lock (Ghostty stays visible when the UI is hidden) unless the quest is about UI.
Game at 1920x1080 or 2560x1440, FPS capped at 60; GIFs recorded at 30 fps and 960 px wide.

quests.name: A Terminal Under the Stars
quests.spot: Costa del Sol, the beach below the villa
setup: /term showcase
Two pets beside you, one screen pinned at the waterline with /term pin here
Settings > World: backlight on, lighting follows time of day
quests.capture: Slow 20 s orbit from the showcase camera: screens glow against the night sea and light your face. Then a still from shot 1.

quests.name: The Drop from Above
setup: Ctrl+` to open and close the dropdown
Three tabs: showcase banner, btop, fastfetch
quests.capture: The glass dropdown sliding down, switching tabs with the icon bar, closing again. A still with the tab bar in focus.

quests.name: Last Call at the Drowning Wench
quests.spot: The Drowning Wench terrace, lanterns behind you
setup: Two pet screens, one showing the palette banner
Settings > Bell: preset aura
quests.capture: Over-the-shoulder still: pets glowing among the lanterns. A second still mid bell ripple (/term bell aura).

quests.name: The Arcanist's Tome
quests.spot: Arcanists' Guild, by the reading tables
setup: /tomestone to bring the terminal out with the device pose
Type a few lines so the typing animation plays
quests.capture: Character draws the glowing device, taps while you type, puts it away on close.

quests.name: Dockside Construction
quests.spot: Moraby Drydocks, the pier beside the aetheryte
setup: One screen out
Alt+drag to carry it
Hold Shift to snap it flat against the crane housing
Ctrl+drag an edge to fit
quests.capture: Pick up a screen, carry it through the air, snap it onto the dock wall, resize to fit. 25 s.

quests.name: Golden Hour at Summerford
use: README: walk-up and pets while moving
quests.spot: Summerford Farms, the path between the fields
setup: Two pets
One screen pinned by the fence
quests.capture: Run down the path with pets trailing and settling, then click the pinned screen: the character walks up and it floats out to meet you.

quests.name: Light in the Grotto
use: README: screens live in the world
quests.spot: Seasong Grotto, inside the cave mouth
setup: Pin a screen behind a rock pillar
Settings > World: screens cast light
quests.capture: Walk behind the pillar so the screen hides behind the rock and your character stays in front; the screen's light on the cave wall.

quests.name: Circling Aleport
quests.spot: The cliffs above Aleport, sea behind
setup: /term pin orbit 4 0.2 twice
quests.capture: Two screens orbiting you at sunset while the camera pulls back. 15 s.

quests.name: Storm Warning
quests.spot: Near the Moraby Bay coast, low-level mobs
setup: Two pets out
quests.capture: Screens tinted by the rain; pull a mob and the screens derez in scanlines, then return when combat ends.

quests.name: Into the Screen
quests.spot: Anywhere with a pinned screen at eye height
setup: A pinned screen running the showcase banner
quests.capture: Double-click the screen: it flies to the centre of the view; double-click again to send it back.

quests.name: A Home Office in Mist
quests.spot: A quiet plot's garden wall (after the quest Where the Heart Is (Mist))
setup: Three screens snapped to the wall with Shift+Alt drag
Optional: Settings > World > Screens cast shadows (experimental)
quests.capture: A still of a wall of terminals at night; a second with shadows on if they render.

quests.name: Five Bells
setup: /term bell demo
quests.capture: All five bell styles rippling from your character in turn, captions included.

quests.name: Every Terminal at a Glance
use: README: taskbar, info bar and Umbra widget
setup: Terminals as tabs, windows, pets and pins
Open the info bar popup and the Umbra widget popup
quests.capture: Crop of the toolbar with the popup listing every terminal.

quests.name: Make It Yours
setup: /term config
Visit Settings, Bell, World, Assistant, About (vote on features)
quests.capture: One still per tab, same window size.

quests.name: Ask the Almanac
setup: /term ask what is the weather at Costa del Sol tonight?
XivMcp window on the Agents tab
quests.capture: A pet terminal opens with the question, the answer streams in, the agent board shows progress.

quests.name: Couch Mode
setup: toggle_gamepad_button = 'create'
Several terminals
quests.capture: Tap Create to open, hold to step through terminals, double-tap to step back, with a controller overlay if possible.

homepage_video.length: about 75 s, 1080p60, music optional, no voice

cuts.note: Open on the night beach, screens glowing. Title: Ghostty for FFXIV.
Ctrl+` drops the glass terminal over Limsa. Caption: Eorzea is a terminal multiplexer.
Carry a screen and snap it to the dock. Caption: put screens anywhere.
Pets trail you; click one and walk up to it.
Your character works a glowing device while you type.
Ask your local assistant from inside the game.
Pull back to the beach. End card: github.com/Spaceghost/ghostty-dalamud and the vote link.
